data.name: Local_Notice
data.value: The tool of the editors. It answers this machine only, shows what is not published and changes the store.

data.name: Home_Lead
data.value: What the store of the editors holds.

data.name: Home_None
data.value: The store holds no collection yet. Bring one in with the command “store import”.

data.name: Collection_Lead
data.value: The working state of the editors – not what the public sees.

data.name: Collection_Waiting
data.value: {0} of {1} statements wait for a review

data.name: Records_Lead
data.value: In the order of the editors. A record leads to what it says and to the history of its changes.

data.name: Record_Now
data.value: The record as it is now

data.name: Record_Gone
data.value: This record was taken out of the collection. Its history is kept.

data.name: History_Lead
data.value: The latest {0} of {1} changes, the newest first.

data.name: Revisions_Lead
data.value: What the store published, each kept as it was published.

data.name: Revisions_None
data.value: No revision has been published from the store.

data.name: NotFound_Text
data.value: The store holds nothing at this address.

data.name: Error_Text
data.value: The page could not be shown. Nothing was changed. What failed is in the log of the tool.

data.name: Act_ByHint
data.value: Kept with the change. The tool does not check who you are.

data.name: Act_NeedsDay
data.value: Give the day as a date.

data.name: Review_Lead
data.value: Who reviewed the statement, on which day and what the review found is kept in the statement and in its history.

data.name: Review_As_reviewed
data.value: Reviewed: read against its sources, it stands

data.name: Review_As_disputed
data.value: Disputed: the sources disagree – the note says about what

data.name: Review_As_withdrawn
data.value: Withdrawn: the statement is taken back – the note says why

data.name: Review_NoteHint
data.value: What the statement was checked against; what is disputed; why it is withdrawn.

data.name: Review_NeedsStatement
data.value: Choose the statement of this record that was reviewed.

data.name: Change_Lead
data.value: The record as it is written in the file of a collection. The whole collection is read with the change before it is kept; what the site could not use is refused with the reasons.

data.name: Change_NotJson
data.value: The text is not a record: {0}

data.name: Change_NotAnObject
data.value: it has to be one object in braces.

data.name: Change_OtherId
data.value: A record keeps its id ({0}). A record with another id is a new record – add it on the page of its group.

data.name: Remove_Lead
data.value: With the texts that translate it. What still points to the record stops this. Its history stays.

data.name: Add_Lead
data.value: A new record of this group, as it is written in the file of a collection. It is added at the end of the group.

data.name: Add_Exists
data.value: A record {0} is there already; change it on its page.

data.name: Add_NeedsId
data.value: A record names itself: it has an id.

data.name: Publish_Lead
data.value: This makes revision {0} out of what the store holds. Every statement has to be reviewed. The store keeps the revision as it is published. Nobody sees it before it is released (above); the command “store revision” writes it out as files.

data.name: Done_published
data.value: The revision was published and is kept in the store.

data.name: Fields_Title
data.value: Change the fields of the record

data.name: Fields_Lead
data.value: Every field the record has, with what it can hold; the text of a field in another language stands below it. A text left empty takes its field out of the record. To give the record a field it does not have yet, change the record as text below.

data.name: Fields_RowsHint
data.value: A row whose texts are all empty is taken out; the last row is for a new one.

data.name: Fields_JsonHint
data.value: As it is written in the file of a collection.

data.name: SignIn_Lead
data.value: The tool of the editors shows what is not published. Sign in with your account.

data.name: SignIn_Refused
data.value: Not signed in. The name or the password is not right, or the account takes no password at the moment.

data.name: Accounts_Notice
data.value: The tool of the editors. It shows what is not published and changes the store; every change is kept under the name of who signed in.

data.name: Stages_Lead
data.value: How far a reader has read. A stage is named without giving away what happens in it. A stage is added in the last row; the last stage is taken out by emptying its name, which works only when no record is told at it.

data.name: Stages_NeedsNames
data.value: Every stage has a name; only the last ones can be left empty.

data.name: Comparisons_Lead
data.value: Subjects side by side over one kind of time. A comparison is kept as a whole, with every change.

data.name: Comparison_AddLead
data.value: The file of a comparison as it is written. It is read as the site reads it; what the site could not use is refused with the reasons.

data.name: Comparison_TranslationHint
data.value: A translation that is emptied is taken out. A further one names its language in its document.

data.name: Comparison_ChangeLead
data.value: The file and its translations are kept in one act and tried together first.

data.name: Comparison_RemoveLead
data.value: Takes the comparison and its translations out of the store. What was changed of it stays.

data.name: Comparison_Exists
data.value: The store already holds the comparison {0}; change it on its page.

data.name: Comparison_NeedsLanguage
data.value: A further translation names a language the comparison is not translated into yet.

data.name: Fields_TimeHint
data.value: kind: “occurrence” is one time (at); “between” lies between two (at, latest); “period” lasted from at – or between at and latest, or from an unknown beginning (start) – until – or between until and untilLatest, or ongoing or unknown (end). A position is a year, with a month and a day where they are stated; “about” where the source says so. “–” states no time.

data.name: Act_Stale
data.value: This was changed by somebody else after you opened the form, so nothing of what you filled in was kept. The form still has what you filled in, on top of what the store holds now; the history at the end of the page says what was changed. Send the form again if your change still holds.

data.name: Role_Writer
data.value: Writes: changes, adds and takes out records, texts, stages and comparisons.

data.name: Role_Reviewer
data.value: Reviews: records that a statement is reviewed, disputed or withdrawn.

data.name: Role_Publisher
data.value: Publishes: makes a revision that everybody may see.

data.name: Role_Needs_Writer
data.value: Your account does not write. Somebody who looks after the accounts can change that.

data.name: Role_Needs_Reviewer
data.value: Your account does not review. Somebody who looks after the accounts can change that.

data.name: Role_Needs_Publisher
data.value: Your account does not publish. Somebody who looks after the accounts can change that.

data.name: Account_RolesNote
data.value: What an account may do is said where the store lies, with a command; the tool has no page for it.

data.name: Account_PasswordLead
data.value: A password has at least {0} characters. Another password signs you out everywhere, here too.

data.name: Account_Differ
data.value: The new password and its repetition differ. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Account_SignIns
data.value: When the password of this account was tried

data.name: Account_SignInsNote
data.value: The newest first. A wrong password you did not type is a reason to change yours. From where somebody tried is not kept.

data.name: New_Lead
data.value: The fields a record of this kind has. A text left empty is a field the record does not have. The site reads the collection with the new record before it is kept.

data.name: New_IdHint
data.value: The identifier names the record for good: lower-case words with hyphens, such as person-ferdowsi. No record of the collection has it yet.

data.name: New_Link
data.value: Add a record with a form

data.name: Language_AddLead
data.value: A language the collection is not translated into yet, as a language tag such as de or ar. It begins empty and as a draft; its texts are then filled in beside the fields of each record.

data.name: Language_Added
data.value: The language was added. Its texts are filled in on the pages of the records.

data.name: Merge_Lead
data.value: When two records turn out to be one and the same, this one goes into the other: every relation, step and image that names it names the other from then on, what is stated about it is stated about the other, and its name stays findable as another name. A likeness of names is no reason; say what shows that the two are one. The history keeps every record as it was before.

data.name: Merge_NeedsOther
data.value: Choose the name this one is the same as.

data.name: Done_merged
data.value: The other record was merged into this one.

data.name: Comparison_FieldsLead
data.value: What the comparison says as a whole: its title, the kind of time it uses, what part of time it shows, and its sources. Its lanes have pages of their own.

data.name: Comparison_LaneLead
data.value: One subject of the comparison: what lasted (periods) and what happened (events), each with its time and its sources. A row that is emptied is taken out, with the texts that translate it.

data.name: Comparison_LaneKeyHint
data.value: The key names the lane for good: a lower-case word such as iran. No lane of the comparison has it yet.

data.name: Comparison_LaneNeedsKey
data.value: A lane has a key: one word without blanks.

data.name: Comparison_LaneRemoveLead
data.value: Takes the lane out of the comparison, with its periods and events and the texts that translate them.

data.name: Files_Lead
data.value: The file of the item, the poster of a video, its captions in a language, its transcript, or a further rendition. What a file is is read from the file itself. Of an image, what it says about where and with which device it was made is taken out; a video is kept as it is – remove such notes before you bring it in. A file that is replaced stays on the machine: the history of the item still names it.

data.name: Files_Part
data.value: What the file is of the item

data.name: Files_Part_file
data.value: its file – the image or the video itself

data.name: Files_Part_rendition
data.value: a further rendition of the file

data.name: Files_Language
data.value: Language of the captions, as a language tag such as en

data.name: Files_NoFolder
data.value: The tool was started without a folder for files (Studio:Files); it cannot keep a file.

data.name: Files_OtherKind
data.value: The file is of another kind than the item: an image for a video, or a video for an image.

data.name: Media_NewLead
data.value: An item is brought in with its file. It starts as an item whose rights are not established and that is not shown to anybody; what it shows, when it was made and whether it may be shown is said afterwards on its page.

data.name: Media_RightsHint
data.value: A file is brought in only for an item that may be shown: something made for this project, or a work its holder releases openly. A work whose rights are not established stays a reference without a file.

data.name: Media_NeedsRights
data.value: Say why the file may be shown: choose what holds for it and write the statement.

data.name: Reports_Lead
data.value: What visitors of the site wrote about a statement. A report is words of a stranger: it changes nothing by itself. Look at the record, change it if the report is right, and note here that it was looked at.

data.name: Reports_Settled
data.value: Noted: the report was looked at.

data.name: Reports_Gone
data.value: That report waits no longer – somebody else has looked at it.

data.name: Reports_Off
data.value: The tool was started without the folder of the reports.

data.name: Sizes_Lead
data.value: This image was brought in before the tool made smaller sizes. With them the pages of the site give a browser the size that fits – the gallery loads small pictures. The image itself is not changed.

data.name: Sizes_None
data.value: No smaller size was made: the image is small already, or it cannot be read.

data.name: Release_Lead
data.value: A site that reads its collections from the database shows the revision named here from its next start on – the newest, or an earlier one again. Publishing a revision shows it to nobody.

data.name: Release_None
data.value: The site shows no revision of this collection.

data.name: Release_Submit
data.value: Show this revision on the site

data.name: Release_NeedsNumber
data.value: Choose one of the published revisions.

data.name: Withdraw_Submit
data.value: Show no revision on the site

data.name: Done_released
data.value: The site shows this revision from its next start on.

data.name: Done_withdrawn
data.value: The site shows no revision of this collection from its next start on. What was published is still kept.

data.name: ComparisonRelease_Lead
data.value: A site that reads from the database shows a comparison as it was when it was released, from its next start on. What is changed afterwards is shown when the comparison is released again.

data.name: ComparisonRelease_No
data.value: The site does not show this comparison.

data.name: ComparisonRelease_AsHeld
data.value: The site shows this comparison as it is here.

data.name: ComparisonRelease_Earlier
data.value: The site shows this comparison as it was released; it was changed since.

data.name: ComparisonRelease_Submit
data.value: Show the comparison on the site as it is now

data.name: ComparisonWithdraw_Submit
data.value: Do not show the comparison on the site

data.name: Done_comparisonreleased
data.value: The site shows the comparison as it is now from its next start on.

data.name: Done_comparisonwithdrawn
data.value: The site does not show the comparison from its next start on.

data.name: Fields_FactsHint
data.value: The facts the kind of this entity has. A row that says nothing is a fact the record does not state; an essential fact that is not stated is shown to readers as not known.

data.name: Publish_Notes
data.value: {0} entities have a profile that lacks something

data.name: Publish_Notes_Lead
data.value: These are notes, not faults: a revision is made with them. A reader sees a drawing of the kind in place of a missing picture, and “not known” for an essential fact that is not stated.

data.name: Proposals_Lead
data.value: Places people say they were at that no collection has an entry for. A proposal is words of a stranger: it changes nothing by itself and says nothing about who wrote it. Decide whether the place gets an entry; if it does, make the name in the collection it belongs to, publish, and note here that it was added – with its entry, so that the trail leads to it.

data.name: Proposals_Entry
data.value: The entry the place has now (optional)

data.name: Proposals_EntryHint
data.value: As collection/name, such as universities/university-of-tehran. Only for a place that was added.

data.name: Proposals_Done_declined
data.value: Noted: the place gets no entry.

data.name: Proposals_Gone
data.value: That proposal waits no longer – somebody else has decided it.

data.name: Proposals_NoEntry
data.value: The store has no name “{0}”. Write the entry as collection/name, or leave the field empty.

data.name: Proposals_PageNote
data.value: an address a visitor wrote; nobody has checked it

data.name: Theme_Same_Title
data.value: The same theme in another collection

data.name: Theme_Same_Lead
data.value: These themes carry one of the identifiers of this theme as exact. The site shows what stands under them together, each under the name of its collection. A name alone joins nothing.
